text:
ana: Kicking off a short thread: goal = webinar + bite-sized battlecard pack for SDRs that targets cloud AI platforms and self-hosted infra vendors. Need core messaging, 3-4 soundbites, and a hard routing decision for inbound demo requests.

jordan: For messaging, I want two lanes: 1) economics (cost per token + throughput) 2) operational risk (fallthrough, reliability, private deploy). headline-idea: 'Serve smarter, ship faster.' simple.

mike: Love 'Serve smarter.' Bench angle: give one concrete datapoint on cost delta and one on p95 latency. e.g. "typical workload: 40% lower per-token cost vs generic managed endpoints; p95 under 350ms in our dedicated config." (will validate).

priya: SDR battlecard needs: quick competitor frame, 4 one-liners (what they say vs what we say), 3 objection responses, and 2 demo prompts they can use live.

ana: @priya (typo) I mean @priya. Also include an escalation cue: if prospect says "SLA" or "air-gapped" route to AE immediately.

priya: Noted. Proposed competitor frames: 
- Cloud AI: "easy, generic endpoints" -> our reply: "fastest path to production with unit-cost controls and routing policies"
- LLM APIs: "best models, hosted" -> reply: "same model families but tuned serving and throughput controls"
- Infra vendors: "you run it, you own it" -> reply: "private deployments with managed control plane + ops playbooks"

mike: For demo prompts: 1) "Show us p50/p95 across burst vs steady state" 2) "Show cost estimate for 1M tokens/day with caching" Those are great to trigger bench talk.

jordan: Routing rules (draft) -> inbound form has fields: company_size, ARR_estimate, security_need, latency_flag. Pseudo: ```if (ARR_estimate >= 100000 OR security_need == 'VPC' OR mentions.includes('SLA')) route = 'ae_enterprise' else if (latency_flag == true) route = 'eng-ops-rapidbench' else route = 'sdr_nurture'```

ana: ops-bot can auto-create a benchmark ticket when latency_flag==true and include sample payload. ops-bot: pls.

ops-bot: created INF-5502 "Rapid bench for inbound request" assigned to @mike due 2026-04-12. :white_check_mark:

priya: Battlecard soundbites (short): 1) "Measure costs, don't guess them" 2) "Fallbacks keep your UX intact" 3) "One API across hosted, dedicated, private" 4) "We optimize serving, not just models" Feedback?

jordan: Tighten 4 -> "Serving-first optimizations, not only model access."

mike: Add a technical blurb for SDRs they can use if the lead is technical: "We use KV-prefix caching, continuous batching, and kernel-aware execution to cut tokens-in-flight and latencies." Keep it one sentence.

priya: Objection handlers (short): 
- Price: "We run a workload model and can show 3 realistic configs; customers usually see 20-45% lower inference spend."
- Reliability: "Canary rollouts and automatic model fallbacks preserve SLAs during load spikes."
- Lock-in: "Same API across deployment options; you can move between hosted and private without rework."

jordan: Also include a short mail subject/test: "How to halve inference surprises — live benchmarks inside" and a 3-line preview for nurture email.

ana: Marketing assets list: webinar landing copy (50-70 words), 1-page bench narrative (with methodology note), 1-pager battlecard for SDRs, email sequence (3 emails), and a short demo checklist for AEs.

mike: Methodology note (one-liner): "Bench runs use synthetic and customer-sampled prompts, 512 token avg, tests across three regions, median of 5 runs; baseline = unmanaged cloud endpoint with default config."

priya: Can someone drop sample numeric ranges? I can turn them into copy. Need p50, p95 ranges and % cost delta ranges.

mike: Draft numbers (placeholder, will verify): p50 = 120-180ms (dedicated) vs 200-350ms (managed baseline). p95 = 300-420ms vs 700-1200ms. cost delta = 15-50% lower per-token depending on batching and cache hit rate. add parenthetical: (internal lab, Q1-2026).

jordan: Good. We'll present as ranges with methodology footnote. Avoid single-point claims.

ana: Timeline: landing + battlecard v0 by EOD Tue, bench one-pager + verified numbers by Thu, email sequence + routing snippet by Fri. Owners: ana=campaign lead, priya=battlecard, mike=bench, jordan=routing + copy QA.

priya: I'll assemble the battlecard and ping for quick review. Also drafting 3 objection roleplay lines SDRs can use over call.

mike: I'll push bench artifacts to the shared drive and flag verified numbers in the doc.

jordan: Once battlecard is in, we should run a quick 1-hour roleplay with SDRs next week. bookable via my calendar.

ana: Thanks all. Small ask: include 2 sentiment hooks for webinar promotions: 1) "Real benchmarks, not vendor slides" 2) "Bring your token profile — we'll model it live" Use emoji.

ops-bot: scheduled meeting "Webinar dry run" on 2026-04-14 10:00 assigned to <@ana>, <@priya>, <@mike>.

ana: Great. closing this thread, will follow up with PRDs and links. :sparkles:
